asr.full_text: 1st Project Allow me to bring to your attention the first project organized by absolutely completely decentralized time agency Forsage. Forsage means Fast and Furious What do Fast and Furious represent? What are your advantages? Forsage marketing was created through an Smart Contract. Smart Contracts gives you maximum security and stability. Smart Contract is an algorithm located in your blockchain, from which ETHERUM is the undeniable leader, the forcing is created on the Ethereum platform. The smart contracts and the cryptocurrencies are decentralized. The terms and conditions of IE contract are set into the program and become undeniable. The code that contains the entire logic of the software is displayed on the blockchain network. All. All additional calculations are provided by millions of computers around the world! So, it is impossible to split the project. All the creation center is impossible to cancel or alter the conditions. One cannot borrow money or limit the income. For this reason, the participants are more motivated in the development of their business. In this project, your growth is not limited by the risks of a standard project. So, how does the forced marketing work? Forced marketing has a matrix strategy, this being the most efficient system from the point of view of customers. The matrix is made up of small positions for which there are no validations. These cycles are made up by the completion of the positions. The logic is very simple and applicable. It is based on peripheral connections, . In the X3S you have a line with three positions. In the X4S you find two lines with two positions in the first line and four lines with two position of position in the second line. When registering on the forces, you download both programs simultaneously. individually, in each program you can find twelve positions. All are identical and work in the same way. Each remaining position is two times more expensive than the previous one, As a consequence, the profits from all in these areas are two times greater. All active positions are fluid and they bring the profits in parallel. How many positions can be activate immediately? As many as you want, even all 12 at the same time. They have no expiration date, so you don't have to worry about it. The general recommendation is to start right away with 3 positions. Although the leaders buy more from the beginning. Recording The first position of each program costs 0.025 Ethereum, but cannot be compared separately. They are bought together for recording. So to get a record in Forsage you need 0.05 ETH. And, further, you can purchase all the other separate deposits. In order from the smallest to the largest. They will develop parallelly, but independently. The X3 program is shorter, so you complete it faster, and active partners come in more substantial sales. In the most cases, when you invite partners, In a short time frame you can start trading faster with your partner and a larger profit is expected. Usually, when you invite your partners, they will take the positions below you. In case of an indirect registration, there is a chance to beat other partners, so you should play as quickly as possible. Prices disabling during the pricing will be automatically done the following way. The payment delay after completing the matrix is carried out automatically as follows. When the first partner occupies the first spot under you, 100% of the fee will be credited into your personal wallet. The same applies when the second partner occupies the second spot under you, and when the third partner occupies the third spot, you get 100% back but for reinvestment. The reinvestment. Reinvestment opens the same position again and you will continue to receive income from it. When your partner get to the reinvestment, they will reopen such position and will complete a empty place on you, consequently 100% of the reinvestment is transferred into your wallet. Sometimes your partner may be more where your partner is more active. For example, let's say he occupies in position 1 your location, but the other place is still available, while your partner has already filled in positions and has come to reinvestment. Therefore, he will occupy the second place. So it's possible that a single active partner will get you moving and bring you revenues. In parallel with the X3 programme, there is the CLEANXX4 programme. Parallel to X3 mode, we have also x4 Forcage mode For some partners, this game is more attractive because of the indirectly signed versions. There is any compilations option there is a possibility that you will be invited to all the six parties but a particular person may stay away to the other party and that may result in indirect signings The visits from the x4 Program comes from the second line, the two places below you occupy the two places in the second line above you, and the 100% money will go to the higher partner wallet. Also, you will receive the same delivery from the second line, 100% from the 4 partners. The 100% returns are immediately handed over in your personal wallet. The last payment closes the position and the partner can invest in the purchase of the same position. Your partners will choose to reinvest so 100% of the payment is transferred to your wallet. Thanks to the reinvestment system, once you open a position, you are already engaged in in this loop just like your partner and you will always receive earnings. The reinvestment process is automatically performed as soon as the last free position is completed. the current position closes and the process repeats. After reinvesting, a partner will occupy a low call in a higher position and will open their own positions with open spaces. And 100% of the fees from a partner's reinvestment go into your portfolio. Therefore, through real investments, the income from each position is unlimited. But there are 12 positions in each program and you will receive a income in absolutely all. Because of that, there is the possibility of upgrading. Upgrading is opening of the next position on a more valuable level. Upgrade is necessary for your partner to follow you. Thus, the lower part of your structure will develop. How can you motivate them? In other matriups, a centralized ring is usually used, namely an automatic upgrade. In order to do this, they, at least two squares must be collected which means that the funds are accumulated in the system but such accumulation makes up the basic principles and does not agree with 100% classified squares per partner network but 100% of the squares are for partners each square is always sent immediately in the portfolio of one of the money are available to the partners. Every form of money is sent immediately into the wallet of one of the participants. There are enough vouchers for each order, both for acquiring the following position and for reinvestment. Partners will buy only upgrades, and the reinvestment is made automatically, because you don't need a deposit. If a participant does not have the next open position, then in the second one, after trading, all the money will be redirected to the upper line. The upgrade is needed to raise the amount. Although the most clever choice would be not to wait until a restatement, but to make the upgrade immediately after the 2 shares were made to drop the next level in anticipation of your partner. You can beat the partner you were talking about getting positions he had not yet reached. In this way you will reach the line above him. You only come to distribute the person closest to having this position. If anyone does not have the necessary position, then you are already on a higher line until the system finds an option partner who already has a designated position. Federal Linke Ng allows you to return everything in place. Thus, when the line above you acquires the same position you will take a place under the next reinvestment. You will be able to protect your partners for always, as, as you can see, every step in the matrix provides you immediate tangible results. In the meantime, there is an unavoidable constant growth. Now let's calculate how you can increase your tickets. For example, in the first week you have broken a level position cycle. In the X3 programming, your ticket is 10,.075 Etherium and in x4 zero of 0.1. In the next week you will take over the cycle of the second position and one more for the first position. And the income is already from 0.3 and 0.4 of Ethereum. If you will move like that with a position on Saturday, then in 12 weeks you will move to the 12th position and your total will be 613.35 ET in the X3 Prog and 817.8 ET in the X4 Pro. a total of 1430 ET. At a exchange rate of $250, it is more than,000$, after that you won't need to upgrade . All positions are activated and you are in a endless cycle of reinvestment that will bring you opportunities. The general recommendation for the majority is to start directly with three positions in both programs at the same time. Admission value is 0.35 ETH%, which is neither too much nor too little most know this recommendation and follow it but the smartest thing is that your partner too follow to make a profit The leaders usually buy multiple positions from the first So in case of a rapid move and upgraded to lower lines they will occupy the first places With this approach your staff will have more profit. And, as you can see, all in the marketing process is thought so there is dynamic movement in all the stages without
